assets.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story.
Asset type: a finished panoramic environment bitmap used directly in a playable indie football management game, NOT a mockup.
Primary request: redraw the supplied football-tunnel reference as premium PAINTERLY PIXEL ART for a cohesive three-environment game-art set.
Input image role: composition reference only, not a photograph to preserve. Keep the recognisable low eye-level brick players' entrance, open iron gate, near touchline and modest floodlit grass opening, but genuinely redraw every material in the new medium.
Style/medium: detailed hand-placed pixel painting, believable proportions and perspective, atmospheric but restrained, like a carefully art-directed classic PC management game. Visible square pixel clusters, clean stepped edges, controlled dither and deliberate large shadow shapes. Logical pixel grid about 384 by 128, presented as a crisp enlarged panoramic image. It must read as authored game background art, never as a photographic image with a pixel filter.
Color palette across the entire set: charcoal #111415, deep pine shadows #18261e, natural football-grass greens #2e713d and #4b9656, desaturated moss #6c8255, warm ivory #d8d0b5, aged tobacco wood #65513c, tiny muted amber #b99864 practical lights. About 24 to 32 related colours, no mint, neon, candy hues, bright red emphasis or glossy surfaces.
Lighting/mood: quiet late evening, low ordinary floodlights, small warm practical lamps, a cool dark sky, balanced readable midtones, no glowing fog or dramatic sunbeams.
Materials: scuffed brown brick, old iron, damp worn paving, chalk and closely cut grass; plausible at a club founded in 1950 and still used later.
Composition: panoramic landscape 3:1, important detail in the central horizontal strip so it survives a shallow in-game crop. The tunnel opens onto grass and a sliver of empty pitch; do not show a full grandstand or fixed stadium bowl, and make no claim about capacity. No people.
Text: none. No lettering, logos, numbers, signs, UI, watermark or split panels.
Output: one finished illustration, not a comparison sheet.
assets.usage: Club home; full stadium illustration with current-world stage, capacity and supporter labels
